Since I'm not receiving any response to the bug reports I open... which remain pending without anyone acknowledging or following up except for the bot, every time I encounter the problem in the system, I will open a new bug report...
It's shameful and scandalous that first the API problems and now this are not being taken seriously. The system has been practically unusable for days... and I have a €200 per month subscription... to use Claude, not to go crazy dealing with continuous bugs.
